title: with-statement shadowing silently rebinds a local to a record field
notes:
Delphi `with` is a syntactic-shorthand whose scope rules silently
shadow outer identifiers when an inner field has the same name.
This is the #1 source of post-migration regressions in any Delphi
port, because neither C# nor Java has a `with` equivalent — the
translator MUST rename or qualify. The trap entry exists so the
extraction prompt's rule #9 (`with` is an edge case) actually fires.
